title: ArtifactStagingGrant
description: Short-lived, content-addressed authority to upload and commit quarantined staging objects without ArtifactVersion finalize authority.
x-semantic-constraints: grant_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the grant excluding grant_digest
the grant binds one Tenant, Platform execution scope and Capability InvocationAttempt and its artifact Gateway binding matches the admitted WorkOrder RunManifest or ArtifactOperation context route
expires_at is later than issued_at and no later than the Capability request deadline or CommercialAuthorization expiration; each use also requires a shorter-lived Artifact Gateway operation token
the Provider may upload and commit quarantined staging objects within the declared media, count and byte limits but cannot finalize an ArtifactVersion
